architecture.aggregation: sort each binary bucket, then aggregate exact global syndrome multiplicities, within-shard pairs, cross-shard pairs, and shared shard-pair incidences
architecture.memory_model: external merge; no all-record in-memory table
architecture.record_key: (45-bit syndrome << 7) | shard_id; 7 shard bits support B<=16 and the frozen implementation uses uint64 records

boundary: The B=16 census covers 3.741 percent of the fixed-coordinate chart. Shards with b>16 and errors omitting the fixed coordinate remain unmerged; no global U6 coefficient is claimed.
partition: A weight-six error containing fixed coordinate 0 is assigned to the primitive shard indexed by the two smallest remaining coordinates 1<=a<b<=B.
theorem: The rigid numeric-minimum shard graph can be replaced by an exact syndrome-first external merge. The implementation reproduces every frozen B=8 supershard count and extends the exact merged census to 120 primitive shards (B=16), 233,088,428 records, and 43,428,489 cross-shard collision edges using 256 radix buckets.
